premise.runsAgainst: deployed pre-PR build (fluidcloudnative/cacheruntime-controller:v1.1.0-36f0467, direct ancestor of merge-base 05f06659) on the live cluster
premise.claim: Issue #6147: when the client component is omitted from CacheRuntimeClass.topology, generateRuntimeConfigData panics (nil deref at cm.go:178), crash-looping the cacheruntime-controller and leaving the Dataset NotBound.
premise.verdict: CONFIRMED live (2026-08-14): RESTARTS 0->3 within minutes of applying the issue's repro, SIGSEGV at cm.go:178 with the exact stack from the issue, Dataset stuck NotBound.

findings.claim: Round 2 status: RESIDUAL, UNREACHABLE IN PRODUCTION. genDataLoadValue still derefs runtimeClass.Topology.Worker with no Topology==nil guard, so a DIRECT call with a topology-less class still panics (canary stays green). But the round-2 revision validates the class in getRuntimeClass (runtime.go) before any caller can reach this code, and all production entry points go through that loader -- verified live in L3 phase 2 (DataLoad against a topology-less class yields a clean error event, no panic). Kept as a canary so any future bypass of the loader flips it.
findings.contradicts: Nothing in round 2 -- the author's revised PR description explicitly acknowledges these four residual derefs (dataload.go:97, image.go:29, sync.go:190, sync.go:214) and argues (correctly) that the loader guard shields them.

findings.claim: Round 1 this was a canary asserting the DataLoad production path (generateDataLoadValueFile -> loader -> genDataLoadValue) panics. Round 2: the canary FLIPPED -- the loader now rejects the topology-less class before genDataLoadValue runs. Promoted to a contract test asserting the error 'at least one component should be defined' and no panic.
findings.l3evidence: L3 phase 2 case B: Warning event 'Failed to setup ddc engine due to error failed to get CacheRuntimeClass verify-b-empty: at least one component should be defined in runtimeClass verify-b-empty', DataLoad RuntimeNotReady, zero panics.

findings.claim: Round 2 status: RESIDUAL, UNREACHABLE IN PRODUCTION. getDataOperationImage (image.go:29) still derefs Topology unguarded on direct call; its only production caller is dataload.go:123, behind the loader validation.

Round 2 status: RESIDUAL, UNREACHABLE IN PRODUCTION. sync.go:190/214 still deref Topology unguarded on direct call; the Sync path loads the class via getRuntimeClass (sync.go:50), which now rejects topology-less classes first.

New in round 2: the choke point itself. getRuntimeClass must reject both `topology: nil` and `topology: {}` (no components) with the 'at least one component should be defined' error. Covers all five downstream call sites (setup.go:39, cm.go:107, sync.go:50, ufs.go:97, dataload.go:56) at once.
findings.evidence: results/L1-smoke-round2.txt (both subtests PASS on PR head 61c71c0); mutation 'drop loader validation call' in results/L1-mutation-coverage-v2.txt turns the scoped suite red, i.e. this guard is covered.

findings.claim: Round 1: the Master and Worker guards had no regression coverage. Round 2: RESOLVED -- the author added table-driven tests (TestGenerateRuntimeConfigDataWithMissingComponentTopology, one case per component) and scripts/mutation-coverage-check-v2.sh confirms dropping the Master or Worker guard now fails the scoped suite.
findings._note: Proven by mutation, not by a test named in this harness. re-verify.sh reports it as Harness-update; re-run mutation-coverage-check-v2.sh by hand.

findings.claim: Round 1: the all-components-nil branch was untested. Round 2: RESOLVED -- TestGenerateRuntimeConfigDataWithoutAnyComponent covers both `topology: nil` and `topology: {}`; mutation v2 shows dropping the all-nil clause fails the scoped suite.

round1.method: Applied the proposed fix (add `runtimeClass.Topology != nil &&` at dataload.go:97, image.go:29, sync.go:190, sync.go:214), re-ran the canaries, then reverted.
round1.result: All four canaries flipped to RED under the fix and returned to GREEN after revert.

round2.method: The round-2 head (61c71c0) IS the fix, so bites = (a) F1b flipped from round-1 canary-pass to contract-pass on the exact production call chain, and (b) mutation v2: dropping the loader validation call (or any component guard, or the all-nil clause) turns the scoped suite red.
round2.result: Both hold. F1/F2/F3 direct-call canaries deliberately stay green (documented residuals).

baselineNoise.warning: The package's Ginkgo suite (TestCacheEngine) shows 12 pre-existing spec failures, IDENTICAL with and without the PR patch -- NOT caused by PR #6157. Never use whole-package pass/fail as a mutation signal. Use `-run 'TestGenerateRuntimeConfigData|TestGenerateDataLoadValueFile'` / `-run 'TestVerify'`, which are green at baseline.
